notes: every chart: chart._ssr false, env.node off, 400 x 300; the first setOption at T0.
events in order at T0 + t; a sample is zr.animation.update(), a refresh of the display list, and a read of what the case's probes name.

cases.note: layout none on a view with two categories, arrows and edge labels: the legend switches category B off -- its nodes fade and shrink, their edges go at once, the view's rect changes so the main group tweens (update timing, no row) while the kept nodes stay at their place in the group and their scale is set at once; switched on again later

layout none: a merge moves two nodes and adds one with an edge; the kept nodes slide (no row), the kept edges' shapes tween at their rows, the new node pops in, the new edge draws out; curved edges (curveness 0.3) with a from-arrow and labels (insideEndTop: beforeUpdate turns them with the tangent); 300 ms cubicInOut, the default update timing

layout none with animationDelayUpdate (idx) => idx * 30 (linear, 1000 ms): a merge moves two nodes; each kept Line's shape waits by its own edge index (LineDraw.updateData's updateProps at the row), each kept node's path scale by its node index, the groups and the view with no row

layout circular, legend off for category B: the circular layout is solved again for the nodes left, so every kept node moves (its group x / y in the main group) and the main group tweens; rotateLabel off
an update while the enter still runs (at 150 of the enter's 1000 ms): a kept edge's percent goes on from where it is to 1 at update timing, its ends move; the nodes' pop-in goes on

a force layout without layoutAnimation (layoutAnimation true turns the series' animation off altogether, GraphSeriesModel.isAnimationEnabled): its iteration runs synchronously in the render and updateLayout stops the node groups' and the lines' tweens -- the paths pop in and scale, nothing slides or draws out; the legend switches category B off (the nodes' x / y written: the iteration starts from them, no random numbers)

a force layout with layoutAnimation (the default): GraphSeriesModel.isAnimationEnabled is false, the series does not animate at all -- the paths are at their scale at once, no line draws out, a legend toggle tweens nothing (the iteration runs on a timer that never fires here: the places are not compared)
a graph on cartesian2d: no view, the nodes' groups slide in pixels, the edges tween in pixels; a value changes

orthogonal LR, curve edges, 1000 ms linear: collapsing 'a' (data index 2) -- its children go to a's place + 1 and fade (removeNode, the update timing), their edges shrink into a's place and fade, the kept nodes slide (the layout changed), the view group tweens to the new rect; then expanding it again -- the children grow out of a's OLD place (sourceOldLayout: __oldX / __oldY)
orient TB, polyline edges: collapsing 'b' removes its TreePath (to the source's place, no opacity) and its children; expanding it builds a TreePath from one child point on b
collapse 'a' and expand it again 300 ms in, before the removal ends: the removed elements are not given back -- new ones are made from the source's old place while the old ones still fade

[R2-H] orient TB, polyline edges: collapse 'b' and expand it again 300 ms in, while its TreePath is still being removed: drawEdge finds b's __edge (removeNodeEdge left it on b) and updateProps it from where it is -- the shape track of the removal stops, its opacity track goes on to 0, and when the removal ends its done takes the TreePath off the group

a tree zoomed by its option (zoom 1.6): the view group is not the identity, and collapsing 'a' (its a21 the deepest node) changes the nodes' bounding rect -- the view group tweens (update timing, no row) under the nodes' own slides, and the compensation scale is set at once
the default update timing (300 ms cubicInOut) and the initial depth: expanding a collapsed 'a2' (data index 4) whose child was never drawn
a radial tree's first render: every label comes out of its node with the path's scale (the text config's rect is the path's, scaled), turned about its centre
a radial tree, collapsing 'b' (data index 6) and expanding it again: the removed labels fade with the node, the new ones come out of b's old place

a radial tree, collapsing 'b' (data index 6) and expanding it again 300 ms in, while b still slides: the new curves start at b's raw place of its previous render (__radialOldRawX), not at where its group is now

a radial tree of symbolSize 0 entering: every path has no scale all along while its label fades in -- the label's rect is the path's (nought), with no stroke margin (lineScale is nought), and it rides the group sliding out of the centre

a radial tree entering with animationDelay (idx) => idx * 30: a later node's path waits at no scale while its group already slides and its label already fades in -- the label's rect is the path's (nought), with no stroke margin (lineScale nought)

a data item's array symbolSize -- [20, '100%'] (the percent of the bar's length, symbolRepeat off), ['50%', 12] repeated (the percent of the category's width), [16] (one number, the second NaN), and a row's array symbolOffset [5, '-50%'] -- read from the item's own visual (visual/symbol.ts getShallow), not the series'
the same on a horizontal bar (the category axis on y): the value dimension is x; a series' one-number array [18] (the second NaN: no glyph); a row's one-number symbolOffset [10] (both ways)

a bar whose emphasis colour is a gradient over a plain colour (discrete: at once), another whose own colour is a gradient and whose emphasis is another gradient (two stops to three), a series whose colour is a gradient with no emphasis colour (createEmphasisDefaultState's liftColor lifts every stop): highlighted and downplayed, the state's fill tweens through zrender's gradient track (300 ms cubicOut, the state animation)

a bar's own colour a radial gradient, its select colour another (the centre and the radius move, two stops each): selected by the action, unselected 400 ms later, selected again 100 ms after that while the unselect's tween still runs; a plain bar beside it selects at once (a colour against a gradient is discrete)

a series whose colour is a gradient with no emphasis colour, its channels ones whose lift (x 1.1) has a fraction of a half or more (5, 15, 25, 45, 75, 105): lift's '| 0' truncates them, it does not round
bars with labels, a merge 100 ms into the enter (a value changes): the kept labels are at rest at once
the same merge adding a bar: its new label fades in at enter timing while the kept ones are at rest
a pie, a merge 300 ms into the enter: the sectors' labels at rest at once
a line with its symbols' labels (each fades in over 300 ms after its symbol's delay), a merge 700 ms into the enter
a sunburst, a merge 300 ms into the enter
a graph with labels (layout none), a merge 200 ms into the enter

guards.name: graph-move: the main group tweens
graph-move: a kept edge tweens its shape
graph-move: a new edge draws out
graph-edge-delay: a later edge waits by its row
graph-legend: a filtered node fades as a ghost
graph-enter-update: useStyle strands the opacity tween
lf-bar: a fade runs, then the render ends it
lf-pie: a fade runs, then the render ends it
lf-line: a fade runs, then the render ends it
lf-sunburst: a fade runs, then the render ends it
lf-graph: a fade runs, then the render ends it
lf-bar-add: the new label fades in
graph-force: no line draws out
graph-force: the paths still pop in
graph-force: a toggle slides nothing
graph-force-anim: no path pops in
tree-collapse: a removed node goes to the source + 1
tree-collapse: an expanded child starts at its parent's old place
tree-polyline: the TreePath shrinks to one child point
tree-midway: a ghost and a new node share a row
radial-midway: a new curve starts at the source's previous raw place, not its group now
radial-enter: a label sits at its distance from a node of no scale
radial-enter: the stroke margin comes with any scale
pict-item-size: a row's [20, '100%'] reaches the glyph
pict-item-size: a one-number array draws nothing repeated
state-gradient: gradient to gradient tweens
state-gradient: a colour to a gradient is at once
state-gradient: liftColor lifts every stop
select-gradient: a radial gradient tweens its radius
